persona.name: Maya Okafor
persona.description: A pediatric nurse in Leeds who loves running. Practical and warm, a little anxious about money.
backstory: I work 12-hour shifts at Leeds Children's Hospital, usually three days a week.
I am training for the Leeds half marathon in May.
My younger brother Tunde lives in Manchester and studies engineering.
I share a flat with my friend Priya, who is a primary school teacher.
I am saving money for a deposit on a flat of my own.
My manager Helen mentioned that a senior nurse position may open this spring.
